description: The JSON export of an audit log. Generated from the reference.

entries.description: The records, newest first. Each one has the fields of a record and two fields that are not hashed.

action.description: What happened, as a stable token such as `override.granted`. Hashed.

actor_member_id.description: The member that acted, or null. Hashed.

agent_member_id.description: The member that owns the agent session, or null. Not hashed.

agent_session_id.description: The agent session that the record is about, or null. Hashed.

created_at.description: The time of the record, in UTC with milliseconds, such as `2026-01-15T12:00:00.000Z`. Hashed as this exact string.

flagged.description: True if `reason` or `meta` quote text that moderation flagged. Hashed.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of `prev_hash` followed by the canonical JSON of the hashed fields, in lowercase hexadecimal.

id.description: The position of the record in the log, as a decimal string. Not hashed.

meta.description: More data about the action. Hashed. A Room denial can include decided_at, the time the hook denied the action.

prev_hash.description: The `hash` of the record before this one. The first record has 64 zeros.

reason.description: The reason that the actor gave, or null. Hashed.

result.description: The last part of `action`, after the last `.` or `-`. Not hashed.

target.description: What the action was applied to. Hashed.

workspace_id.description: The team that the log belongs to. Hashed.

next_cursor.description: Null in an export. In a page, the id to pass to get the next page.

title: Audit export
